ideas.title: Following the Money in Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial aspects of child care fraud, including how fraudulent activities are funded and how money is laundered.
questions: How are child care facilities being defrauded?
What are the financial consequences of child care fraud?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a larger pattern of financial fraud and money laundering in child care facilities, and could lead to further investigations and prosecutions.
